steps.title: go mod init
steps.why: The toolchain writes this file. Typing it out teaches nothing except the format of a file you will never edit by hand.

steps.title: main.go — the smallest program that runs
steps.why: func main, a log line, exit. It compiles and does nothing, which is the point: everything after is an addition to something that already works.

steps.title: app.go — an http.Server on a port
steps.why: Bind :8080 and serve. Still no routes — a 404 from your own server is the first real feedback loop.

steps.title: router.go — one literal route
steps.why: A chi mux with GET /healthz returning 200. This file is the spine: every act from here adds one line to it.

steps.title: curl the health route
steps.why: Ends evening one with a running server answering a request.

steps.label: INSERT
steps.sql: INSERT INTO node_field_definitions (node_id, field_key, display_name, field_type, chart_type, unit, importance) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (node_id, field_key) DO NOTHING

steps.label: UPDATE
steps.sql: UPDATE node_field_definitions SET field_type = $3, chart_type = $4 WHERE node_id = $1 AND field_key = $2

steps.label: INSERT
steps.sql: INSERT INTO node_metrics (ts, metric_name, metric_value, node_id, org_id, hmac_sha256) SELECT $1::timestamptz, m.name, m.value, $4::uuid, $5::uuid, $6::bytea FROM unnest($2::text[], $3::float8[]) AS m(name, value) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
